name: Dart
description: This weapon is a thrown weapon for all intents and purposes. However, it was not meant to be a melee weapon. If you attack with it in melee, you reduce the damage dice by 1 dice step, and you attack at triple the speed factor of the weapon.

name: Finesse
description: You may use your Precision in place of your Brawn for attack and damage rolls with this weapon.

name: Hand and a Half
description: Medium sized creatures can weild this weapon in two-hands, increasing the damage dice by 1 dice step. Small sized creatures treat Hand and a Half weapons as if they had the two-handed property instead.

name: Heavy
description: Small sized creatures cannot wield this weapon.

name: Horseback
description: If you attack with this weapon while ridding a steed, you can ignore the two-handed property of the weapon, and increase the damage dice by 1 step.

name: Lashing
description: Lashing weapons damage dice changes when dealing damage to creatures wearing certain armors: increase the damage dice by 2 steps if your target is unarmored, decrease the damage dice by 1 step if the target is wearing medium armor, decreased the damage dice by 2 steps if the creature is wearing heavy armor. Creatures wearing plate armor are immune to lashing weapon damage.

name: Light
description: In order to engage in two-weapon fighting, both weapons you are weilding must be light. Weapons must also have a bundled EP value for a small creature to utilize this proeprty.

name: Non Leathal
description: If you deliver a subduing attack with a weapon that has the Non-Lethal property, you do not suffer penalties on your attack rolls.

name: Reach
description: When wielding a weapon with the Reach property, your melee range with that weapon is 10 feet. However: you reduce your damage dice by 1 dice step if you attack a creature within 5 feet of you, and do not threaten squares 5 feet out from you either.

name: Reload
description: After firing a projectile with this weapon, you must spend 1 Action reloading the weapon before you can fire it again. Weapons with both Reload and Two-Handed require 2 actions to reload.

name: Sneaky
description: When you deal ambush damage, increase the dice step of this weapon, as well as dice rolled for ambush damage by 1 dice step.

name: Thrown
description: You can throw this weapon, the range of which is listed in the range column. When you do so, you attack at 1/2 the speed factor listed for the weapon, and reduce the damage dice by 1 dice step.

name: Two-Handed
description: Medium sized creatures must wield this weapon in two hands. Small sized creatures treat this weapon as if it had the Heavy Property.
